headline: Is this connection heading for commitment, or staying as it is?
note:
CONNECTION-VOCAB family (2026-08-27). Angle `commitment-connection`.

Both halves of her fork are unsayable — a promise that it moves, or a verdict that it never will. Cut 3 refuses the FORK rather than picking a side.

🔴 Same no-ongoing-contact rule as the rest of the family.

VOC: fb-tarot/docs/drafts/rewrites/_voc-commit-vocab-2026-08-27.md
Manuscript: fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-commit-vocab-2026-08-27.md

a: You turned the Magician. The cards were face down, and your hand chose the one who places nothing by accident.
Every item on his table has been set down deliberately.
You asked which way this is heading. What catches me is that nothing there was placed by accident.
And yet no direction has been declared. You've been given neither answer.
What keeps this undeclared keeps it that way without a sound. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what that comes down to…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You couldn't see them, and you found the one seeing it all the other way up.
He hangs the other way up, and his face is entirely calm.
You asked whether it moves or stays, dear. This card puts the pause itself in front of me.
Still, nothing has been decided. And you've been reading it two ways.
Something appears right where a direction would be chosen. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what appears there…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs gave nothing away, and your hand went to the one holding something lightly.
Look at the white rose in his hand. He's holding it loose.
You asked which way this goes. This card brings me to a direction that hasn't been fixed.
But nothing has been chosen out loud. And you're holding both possibilities.
There's something between this and either answer. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's underneath it…
